name: Field jacket · sample approval
brief:
Product: Field jacket, sample revision B.
Outer fabric must be 600D polyester.
All front zippers must be YKK.
Size range must include XS to 3XL.
Pre-production samples must arrive by 15 November 2026.
Care labels must be provided in Polish and English.
reply:
Hi Kacper,
We can offer 600D polyester for the outer shell.
We will use SBS front zippers to keep the target price.
Our size range is XS to 3XL.
Samples will be dispatched on 15 November 2026; transit normally takes 5–7 days.
Please confirm if we can proceed.
Best regards, Alex

findings.supplier_quote: We can offer 600D polyester for the outer shell.
findings.explanation: The supplier's stated fabric matches the brief. Physical material has not been verified.

findings.requirement_quote: All front zippers must be YKK.
findings.supplier_quote: We will use SBS front zippers to keep the target price.
findings.explanation: SBS is proposed instead of the required YKK brand.
findings.question: Can you confirm YKK front zippers and any resulting price change?

findings.requirement_quote: Size range must include XS to 3XL.
findings.supplier_quote: Our size range is XS to 3XL.
findings.explanation: The stated size range matches the requirement.

findings.requirement_quote: Pre-production samples must arrive by 15 November 2026.
findings.supplier_quote: Samples will be dispatched on 15 November 2026; transit normally takes 5–7 days.
findings.explanation: Dispatch on the arrival deadline plus transit time does not meet the requested arrival date.
findings.question: Can you bring dispatch forward so samples arrive by 15 November 2026?

findings.requirement_quote: Care labels must be provided in Polish and English.
findings.explanation: The reply does not address care label languages.
findings.question: Please confirm that care labels will be provided in both Polish and English.
